committed_before: any timed run (and any other measured run) of this node

timing_prefix.counters: perf stat -x, -e instructions:u,cycles:u around every timed process, one arm per process (perf_event_paranoid 1)

load_record: the 1-minute load average read from /proc/loadavg by the timed process at its start, recorded in its log
quality_rule: a wall comparison (one arm against R in one regime) is decidable only if every process it uses (all timed processes of both arms in that regime and measurement) started at a 1-minute load average <= 3.0, or if the measured ratio clears the frozen threshold 1.15 by a factor of 2 on the deciding side (>= 2.30 decides PASS, <= 0.575 decides FAIL); otherwise it is NOT_DECIDABLE
remeasurement: at most 3 measurements per regime; a comparison is decided by the first measurement in which it is decidable; every measurement is kept; no measurement is discarded for its result
cost_per_attempt_label: a wall value of the cost-per-attempt measurement is authoritative if all its processes started at a 1-minute load average <= 3.0, otherwise diagnostic_only (no threshold)
never: a frozen threshold is never moved; a timed process is never re-run to replace a kept measurement
